summary: The fix describes incorrectly accepting forbidden consecutive digit separators when the unchecked-prefix optimization splits a skip iterator at a separator boundary. It restricts that optimization to contiguous iterators, preserving separator context. However, lexical-util/src/skip.rs already makes take_n return None for non-contiguous iterators at both revisions, so the proposed verbatim reversal appears behaviorally redundant. No detecting upstream test was found: the commit adds no tests, and existing integer separator tests use short i32 inputs that bypass the changed path. Blocked pending a detecting upstream test; no builds or tests were run.
